admission.justification: The obligation is asserted by its own cases and its failure would let the send-back act on a seat that is working or limited; its one realization is deliberate, so it claims no span.

applicability: Every message to a limited recipient on role_message, the developer's tray send and report_to_architect.
conditions: The message is held with the reason and the reset time, also when the recipient is idle.

When the reset time is known, hold admission and drain pause schedule the recipient in the durable reset index, startup adoption enrolls saved limited waits, and the independent 16-worker reset scheduler delivers held messages in order at reset (within about 30 seconds up to about 300 due recipients, and at about 11 recipients per second beyond).
An archived recipient found through the publication's ended stamp is still answered, and a closed session keeps its messages waiting.
exclusions: The presenter's send is out of scope, because it holds no role seat.
No text matching decides the hold.
A wait call answers held at once and does not wait.
statement: A message to a limited seat waits for reset. When a reset time is known, the durable reset index and independent 16-worker reset scheduler deliver held messages in order once the recipient is ready at reset: within about 30 seconds for up to about 300 due recipients, and at about 11 recipients per second for larger backlogs.
title: Provider-limited held-message waiting and post-reset delivery
